title: Fallout 4 plugin file format: TES4 header, GRUP groups, records and subrecords

provenance.source: fopdoc, maintained by the TES5Edit team
provenance.note: Index page. The fourteen per-record subrecord pages are linked but were not individually captured.
Data\PipMonTestFacility.esp is 66 bytes and xEdit reports 'Header processed. Expecting 0 records', CRC32 E1DD5E4D.

prose: A plugin is a TES4 header followed by a sequence of GRUP groups, each holding records; each record is a fixed header followed by subrecords. Sizes here are from the upstream format documentation and are stated as integers so offsets can be computed. THE 24-BYTE RECORD HEADER IS THE NUMBER TO CHECK: our own tools/make_empty_esp.py was written against an assumed 16-byte prologue, which disagrees with the documented 24. That assumption is unverified and is recorded as an open discrepancy rather than quietly corrected, because correcting it by editing the tool would be exactly the kind of unmeasured change this project refuses. A 66-byte header-only plugin is therefore consistent with 24 bytes of TES4 header plus flags and version fields, and must be re-derived from the spec before any generator writes a file.

open_discrepancies.detail: make_empty_esp.py assumes a 16-byte TES4 prologue. Documented record header is 24 bytes. Not yet reconciled.
